menu.style: dinner buffet with one carving station
menu.service_notes: Buffet open 17:45-19:15 only. Carving station is lamb and a roasted-cauliflower option, chef attendant. Dessert held until the last award, then tray service so the room stays dark. Hosted beer and wine [PACKAGE] from 17:00 to last call 20:45; no spirits. Water and wine poured quietly during the program.

items: bitter greens and roasted pear (vegetarian; vegan without the cheese crumble, served on the side)
carved lamb shoulder, herb yogurt on the side
roasted cauliflower steak at the carving station (vegan)
citrus olive-oil cake, berry compote; a labeled gluten-free almond-free cup for 12

bar.inclusions: beer and wine only; no spirits

dietary.note: cauliflower, greens, rice, roots, dessert; 8 of these are vegan and skip the cheese crumble and yogurt
labeled dessert cups; confirm sauces at the carving station

room_setup.style: rounds facing a low podium; buffet on the south wall, bars on the north wall
room_setup.seating: assigned, winners' table of 10 closest to the podium (one of the 16)
room_setup.other: See floor plan [ATTACHMENT]. White floor-length linen, rust napkins, no overlay, no open flame, centerpieces under 14 inches. Award table stage left, skirted white. Step-and-repeat in the corridor, client-provided. Aisle clearance for a single camera at the rear. Seat capacity 160.

av.notes: Clips on a labeled drive at load-in. Tech check 16:30. No live streaming in this sample. House operator only.
